artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from multiple moderate artifacts. 1) Text gibberish on background highway signs (confirmed by OCR expert with low confidence). 2) Structural collapse/grounding failure of the central yellow barrier (floating appearance, lack of contact shadows). 3) Texture anomaly on the yellow barrier (overly smooth, smeared graffiti).
